def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    beginning_inventory_cost = 1250.00
    beginning_inventory_units = 200

    purchase_costs = [116.00, 440.00]
    purchase_units = [20, 80]

    units_sold = 10

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_inventory_cost = beginning_inventory_cost + sum(purchase_costs)
    total_inventory_units = beginning_inventory_units + sum(purchase_units)

    weighted_average_cost_per_unit = total_inventory_cost / total_inventory_units
    cost_of_goods_sold = weighted_average_cost_per_unit * units_sold

    # Return answer rounded to the nearest cent
    return round(cost_of_goods_sold, 2)
